_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Companion phrase pack: phrases/classical/ (Phase ML.4 -- the public-domain cluster; six verbatim PD melody hooks + three verbatim PD bass ostinati, each carrying provenance.pdSource). Encoded from docs/idiom-research/genre-jazz-blues-classical.md GENRE 3; GM programs 0-based (source-book 1-based: 41 Violin -> 40, 43 Cello -> 42, 1 Piano -> 0). Swing is 0 EVERYWHERE -- baroque and romantic lines are dead straight (section 8 trap 2). Tempo band is loop tempo, not concert tempo. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Classical
blurb: Classical-as-loops: real public-domain themes on violin and flute over a Bach broken-chord cello ostinato, detached piano stabs, and a soft brushed pulse - dead straight, never swung.

flavors.label: Chorale Adagio
flavors.blurb: Hymn pace: two plain triads a phrase, sustained four-part voicing, no arpeggio.

flavors.label: Alberti Allegro
flavors.blurb: Classical-period bright major: pure triads, a chord a bar, broken-chord left hand.

flavors.label: Baroque Sequence
flavors.blurb: Circle-of-fifths churn, one chord per bar, detached and dead on the grid.

flavors.label: Lament Ground
flavors.blurb: Descending minor ground bass under sustained strings, cadencing on a major five.

flavors.label: Nocturne Pedal
flavors.blurb: One chord held for four bars while a rolling triplet arpeggio does all the moving.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Common-practice tonality: diatonic triads over functional bass motion, sequences falling by fifths, suspensions resolving down by step. In minor always raise the leading tone so V is major or a dominant seventh, because a flat-seven cadence reads as modal, not classical. Cadence every four or eight bars, perfect or deceptive to flat-VI. Rhythm is dead straight, never swung.
